subject: Commercial MAP & Eval Plan — proposed timeline, bundle options, and discount cadence
messages:
From: Elena Diaz <elena@novaai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Mike Roberts <mike.roberts@novaai.com>, procurements@novaai.com
Date: Mon, 09 Mar 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro — evaluation & timeline

Marissa — thanks for the call earlier.

As discussed, we'd like a one-page mutual action plan (MAP) and an evaluation schedule that ties to commercial milestones. High-level asks from our side:
- 6-week evaluation window with performance SLAs for latency and availability
- A pilot commit after Week 3 if latency and cost targets are met
- Pricing tiers that scale with committed GPU-hours; need clear ramp discounts
- Add-on options: longer observability retention (90d -> 365d), premium support, and credits for embeddings during onboarding

Could you send a draft MAP and the pricing/packaging options by EOD Thursday? Procurement will need a draft SOW to review in parallel.

Best,
Elena
Director of Platform Integrations
Nova AI

--
Attachment: none
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Elena Diaz <elena@novaai.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commercial MAP & Eval Plan — initial draft and options

Elena — really appreciate the clarity. Attached is a first-pass MAP (NOVA_MAP_v1.xlsx) plus a short pricing summary. Key points in the draft:

1) Evaluation plan (6 weeks):
   - Week 0: onboarding + shared test prompts + baseline latency test (1 day)
   - Week 1–3: performance validation (throughput, 95p latency), usage profile capture
   - Week 3: checkpoint — if targets met, Nova signs Pilot Commit (3-month reserved capacity window)
   - Week 4–6: scale tests + production readiness checklist; final commercial review end of Week 6

2) Commercial tie-ins:
   - Pilot Commit: 3-month minimum at an introductory committed GPU-hour rate (Pricing_Summary.xlsx)
   - Ramp Discounts: 10% at 3x baseline commit, 18% at 5x, 25% at 10x (applies to hosted API units or Dedicated credits)
   - Early-exit option with 30-day notice after month 2 (to reduce procurement friction)

3) Bundles / Add-ons:
   - Observability retention: default 90d; add-on to 365d for +$X/mo or equivalent credits
   - Premium Support: 24x7 with a named SE + 1-hr response SLA for P1s — priced as a % uplift of committed spend
   - Onboarding credits: one-time embedding credits to smooth evaluation token costs

I copied Sean and Rishi to confirm that the discount ramps and the named-SE premium support model are approved for a pilot offer. Happy to iterate — can we do a 30-min sync Wed 10:30 PT?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

Attachments: NOVA_MAP_v1.xlsx, Pricing_Summary.xlsx
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commercial MAP & Eval Plan — internal pricing check

Marissa — saw the draft. High-level: comfortable with the ramp bands and onboarding credits. A few internal notes before we share final with procurement:
- Confirm margin impact if we extend observability retention to 365d (ask infra ops for delta)
- Premium support as % uplift looks fine; for Named SE we should require a minimum 6-mo pilot commitment or higher seat fee
- Early-exit language: ok but add a one-time termination fee to guard for capacity reservation abuse

Rishi — can you ok the 25% max discount at scale? If not, what ceiling should we put for pilots that can convert to reserved Dedicated?

-Sean
VP Sales Ops

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 12:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commercial MAP & Eval Plan — discount ceilings

Looping in my quick review:
- 25% top-line discount is acceptable for committed Dedicated capacity with a 12-month equivalent revenue guarantee. For a 3-month pilot commit we should cap discounts at 12–15% unless they increase spend quickly (documented ramp clause).
- Approve onboarding credits and embeddings credit cap of $5k for the evaluation window.
- Observability retention to 365d should be an add-on SKU with clear incremental charge; we should not include it in the pilot commitment by default.

Marissa — revise the Pricing_Summary.xlsx to show two commercial tracks: Pilot (3-month) and Reserved (12-month) with the discount bands and ramp triggers called out explicitly. Once done, circulate to Elena and procurement.

Thanks,
Rishi
Head of Revenue Operations
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Elena Diaz <elena@novaai.com>, Mike Roberts <mike.roberts@novaai.com>, procurements@novaai.com
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commercial MAP & Eval Plan — updated proposal and SOW stub

Elena / team — attached is an updated MAP and a short SOW stub (SOW_draft.pdf). Changes per internal review:
- Two-track commercial model: Pilot (3-month) + Reserved (12-month) with explicit ramp triggers
- Pilot discount ceiling: 15%; Reserved discounts up to 25% with a 12-month equivalent commitment
- Onboarding embedding credits: $5k cap during evaluation
- Observability retention 365d offered as add-on SKU ($$$, details in Pricing_Summary.xlsx)
- Premium Support: priced as 8% uplift on committed monthly spend for the pilot; for Reserved deals we can negotiate a fixed named-SE fee instead

Next steps we propose:
1) Procurement to review SOW_draft.pdf and share redlines by Mon 15 Mar
2) Nova sign Pilot Commitment worksheet by end of Week 3 (target 20 Mar) to unlock onboarding credits and dedicated SE scheduling
3) Execution of evaluation tests per MAP; joint checkpoint at end of Week 3

Can we get a procurement contact to confirm timeline? Also — happy to run a brief session on retention tradeoffs for your infra team if helpful.

Best,
Marissa

Attachments: SOW_draft.pdf, NOVA_MAP_v1.xlsx, Pricing_Summary.xlsx
From: procurements@novaai.com <procurements@novaai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Elena Diaz <elena@novaai.com>
Cc: Mike Roberts <mike.roberts@novaai.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 11:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commercial MAP & Eval Plan — procurement redlines and next steps

Marissa / team — procurement here. We reviewed the SOW_draft.pdf and have two priority items before we can sign the Pilot Commitment worksheet:

1) Liability & data handling: need a clear statement about data residency (we require US-only for inference logs) and SOC 2 evidence for the hosted API. Please add a clause to the SOW or a separate appendix that confirms log residency and a reference to your SOC 2 report.

2) Pricing & termination: request that the Pilot Commit includes a 14-day cure period and that any termination fee be capped at the unused committed credits (we'd prefer no punitive flat fee). Also asking that the onboarding credits be applied to the invoice for the first month rather than as a post-facto credit.

If you can accept (1) and (2) with a clean SOW update by Tue 17 Mar, procurement will circulate the internal PO and we can sign by end of next week. We confirm target evaluation start week of 22 Mar.

Regards,
Procurement Team
Nova AI

Attachment: procurement_redlines_0315.pdf
